title: This makes the installation of the meta package a little less fragile since we won't have to add each machine individually. Instead we match on a modalias string that clearly identifies an Qualcomm X1E SOC.
description:
This makes the installation of the meta package a little less fragile since we won't have to add each machine individually. Instead we match on a modalias string that clearly identifies an Qualcomm X1E SOC.

The package might need another update later to remove the flash-kernel dependency once kernels are built with stubble.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index e4d2506..be4cf9e 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+ubuntu-x1e-settings (28) questing; urgency=medium
+
+  * Relax modalias rule, match on x1e80100-cpucp-mbox
+
+ -- Tobias Heider <tobias.heider@canonical.com>  Fri, 22 Aug 2025 14:13:56 +0200
+
 ubuntu-x1e-settings (27) questing; urgency=medium
 
   [ Aleksandrs Vinarskis ]
diff --git a/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases b/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
index 419c756..4b35ca8 100644
--- a/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
+++ b/debian/hwe-qcom-x1e-meta.modaliases
@@ -1,13 +1 @@
-alias dmi:*:svnAcer:pnSwiftSF14-11* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnASUSTeKCOMPUTERINC.:pnASUSVivobookS15* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnASUSTeKCOMPUTERINC.:pnASUSZenbookA14* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnDellInc.:pnInspiron14Plus7441* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnDellInc.:pnLatitude7455* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnDellInc.:pnXPS139345* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnHP:pnHPOmniBookXLaptop14* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnLENOVO:*:pvrThinkPadT14sGen6* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnLENOVO:*:pvrYogaSlim714Q8X9* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnMicrosoftCorporation:pnMicrosoftSurfaceLaptop,7thEdition* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
-alias dmi:*:svnMicrosoftCorporation:pnMicrosoftSurfaceLaptop,11thEdition* hwe-qcom-x1e-meta
